objective: Improve the smallest defensible patch until the selected release profile passes while preserving Jamie's voice, public safety, claim boundaries, and the existing architecture.
invariants: The public site remains a purposeful projection from the knowledge bank, not an evidence dump.
No score may be improved by weakening a claim boundary, hiding a failure, or publishing protected material.
Staging remains non-indexable and production indexing remains an explicit human-approved action.
Candidate changes stay bounded to the highest-value failing criterion.
Evaluation definitions do not change during a candidate comparison.

hardGates.description: Required application, knowledge-bank, evaluation, and deployment files exist without unresolved merge markers.
The candidate is bound to a content fingerprint, improves on an immutable baseline, and does not regress any protected rubric.
At least five candidate-bound independent model judgments pass with distinct lenses and no reported regression.
A dedicated Chad-editorial judgment confirms courageous precision, legibility, visible agency, useful outcomes, and right-sized claims.
A dedicated Margaret Morse judgment confirms that embodied, artistic, material, social, and place-based inquiry remains legible rather than being reduced to organizational utility.
A dedicated Warren Sack judgment confirms recursive relational thinking, computational prototyping, physical-digital translation, source rigor, and collaborative architecture.
The existing public-safety scanner passes and no public surface exposes protected material.
Knowledge-bank and citation checks pass without weakening attribution, guardrails, or anti-claims.
The approved PDF exists, downloads from the declared path, retains the phone number outside HTML, and agrees with the public chronology.
Canonical route and redirect checks pass.
The homepage and role-fit page provide direct paths to selected work, the resume, and contact.
Static semantic proxies pass; an independent browser judge must still inspect mobile, zoom, focus, and citations.
A reviewed commit SHA, production smoke result, indexing state, and rollback evidence are explicitly supplied.
Jamie explicitly approves the exact production candidate and deploy.

rubrics.question: Can a hiring manager identify Jamie's role, value, and target work in 30 seconds?
Does the selected entry page answer why Jamie fits technical operations, product operations, or implementation work?
Are accomplishments strong, specific, source-backed, and no stronger than the evidence?
Can a reader inspect what each important source supports and where it stops?
Is the path concise, scannable, and free of internal governance narration?
Does the site make Jamie visible, name the actual work and useful outcome in one pass, translate specialized language, and preserve collective credit without understating or inflating the record?
Does the portfolio preserve the connection among embodied inquiry, artistic experimentation, material and spatial practice, participation, memory, and place without obscuring professional legibility?
Does the portfolio show Jamie tracing relationships recursively, turning them into source-backed prototypes and interfaces, and connecting computational, social, physical, and collaborative systems?
Do approved artifacts help readers see the work without exposing protected material?
Do the website and resume reinforce one coherent professional history?
Does hierarchy remain clear on mobile, desktop, keyboard navigation, and zoom?
Are titles, descriptions, social previews, links, and contact paths trustworthy?
Could another operator deploy, verify, diagnose, and roll back this exact version?
